scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p web --noEmit && tsc -p tools --noEmit && tsc -p functions --noEmit && tsc -p extension --noEmit
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w web
scripts.check: npm run check:secrets && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate && npm run verify -w extension
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run package -w extension && npm run build -w web && firebase deploy --only hosting
